hypotheses.title: Batch 67: Orthogonal Super Alpha Cross-Asset Breakout (Unlocking Self-Correlation < 0.60)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Pivots strategically away from saturated single-factor options models by fusing high-statistical-power engines across orthogonal datasets and unmined scopes: (1) Operating Income Yield + Audited Annual FX in TOP1000 (Industry Neutral): Recombines our verified low-correlation TOP1000 engine (self-corr 0.5568) with audited 10-K currency translation to guarantee self-correlation < 0.55 while targeting Fitness >= 1.60. (2) Consensus Forward Net Income Yield + Audited Annual FX in TOP1000: Translates the Sharpe 2.02 analyst engine into large-caps with Industry neutralization. (3) 3-Year LEAP Call IV (1080d) + Audited Annual FX in TOP1000: Deploys 3-year options maturity (never submitted in TOP1000) with corporate balance-sheet hedging. (4) Consensus Net Income Yield + VWAP Reversion in Market Scope: Combines forward consensus earnings with intraday liquidity dislocation in Market scope.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if multi-asset drivers share latent factor exposures during market regime transitions.
